selectedSlice: A — pure exact-batch recorded physical balance projection
purpose: Derive recorded physical balance over an explicit supplied evidence set, without claiming authoritative current quantity-on-hand.

projection.input: One production batch validated through validateFoodProductionBatchVersion plus an actual array whose every entry validates through validateFoodPhysicalInventoryMovement.
projection.formula: producedPackageCount + sum(adjustment-in packageCount) - sum(adjustment-out packageCount) - sum(waste packageCount)
projection.emptyMovements: Valid; balance equals historical production baseline and movementIds is empty.
projection.batchBinding: Every movement must match exact supplied batch ID/version; mismatches reject rather than filter.
projection.skuBinding: Every movement must match exact batch SKU ID/version; mismatches reject.
projection.duplicates: Duplicate movement IDs reject, including identical and divergent payload duplicates. No silent deduplication.
projection.ordering: Movement order is irrelevant; movementIds uses deterministic sorted canonical string ordering, without locale dependence or caller mutation.
projection.arithmetic: Exact internal BigInt accumulation. Only the final balance is bounded inclusively by +/- Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, then converted to number. Transient large sums do not cause order-dependent errors.
projection.negative: Negative recorded balances are valid signed safe-integer evidence outputs, exposing overdrawn recorded history. Never clamp, reject merely for negativity, or equate with literally negative physical stock.
projection.invalidInput: Synchronous TypeError rejection consistent with existing pure domains; no storage result vocabulary.
projection.immutability: Completely detached/frozen outer result, exact batch/SKU references and movementIds array.
projection.time: No clock, date filtering, cutoff selection, or latest/current inference; use precisely the supplied set.

notAuthority: Recorded balance is not authoritative current quantity-on-hand.
Does not prove all movements or physical events were recorded/supplied, a current cutoff, truthful evidence, operational permission, or equality to real-world stock.
No IO, persistence, database reads, asynchronous API, or mutable balance storage.
No trusted inventory execution, authentication, or authorization.
No atomic negative-stock write prevention; removal/reconciliation/concurrency policy remains future work.
No fulfillment/handoff removal or order/payment quantity subtraction.
No reservation accounting; held packages remain physically present.
No stocked SKU capacity or available-to-promise derivation.
Physical packaged inventory does not establish made-to-order capacity.
deferred: Trusted inventory execution and explicit removal/reconciliation policy
Atomic negative-stock enforcement with concurrency proof
Stocked SKU capacity and reservation-aware availability
migration: No migration changes or indexes. Migrations 0003 and 0004 remain unchanged and unexecuted.
validation: Synthetic-only focused and X+Y+Z regression tests, complete FOOD suite, bounded strict TypeScript, zero-warning lint, JSON parse, exact file scope and UTF-8 hygiene.
delivery: Exactly three new unstaged files; no canonical modifications, staging, commit, push, migration execution, production access, deployment, or FOOD-006A.
